name: University of Bologna
summary: Public university in Bologna, Forlì, Rimini and Ravenna; eleven English degrees, most ranked on the SAT, each with its own EU places.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma: 24+ points with 12 at HL, TOK, EE and CAS passed; ask the IB to send your scores. Each degree ranks you on its own test: mostly the SAT, some CEnT-S or TOLC-E.

programmes.name: Building Construction Engineering
programmes.about: Between engineering and architecture: designing, building and restoring buildings, on an international programme taught entirely in English in Ravenna.
programmes.ib: Ranked on the CEnT-S test (first and second rounds); a possible extraordinary round uses the SAT. Most places are for non-EU applicants.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your weighted CEnT-S score. 30 EU places in each of the first two rounds. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Business and Economics
programmes.about: Business and economics in English in Bologna, using data and analytics to shape strategies for companies, institutions and communities; double-degree options.
programmes.ib: SAT required to apply; ranked on SAT score alone, no minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score only. EU places: 85 in round 1, 60 in round 2. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: round 1 10 Feb–4 May; round 2 to 3 July; extra 3–11 Sep

programmes.name: Economics and Finance
programmes.about: Economics and finance taught entirely in English in Bologna, looking at how global markets work and what they mean locally.
programmes.ib: SAT required to apply; ranked on SAT score alone, no minimum.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score only. EU places: 50 in round 1, 40 in round 2. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: round 1 10 Feb–4 May; round 2 to 3 July; extra 3–11 Sep

programmes.name: Economics of Tourism and Cities
programmes.about: Economics applied to tourist destinations and cities: analysing and rethinking strategies and policies for urban life and sustainable tourism, in Rimini.
programmes.ib: SAT required (scores from 1 February 2024); ranked on SAT score alone.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score only. EU places: 35 in round 1, 35 in round 2. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Economics, Politics and Social Sciences
programmes.about: Economic, political and social questions in a globalised world, studied together in English in Bologna across economics and political science.
programmes.ib: SAT required to apply; minimum eligible SAT score 1100.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score; 1100 is the minimum to be ranked. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: round 1 10 Feb–4 May; round 2 to 3 July; extra 3–11 Sep

programmes.name: Genomics
programmes.about: Biotechnology focused on the genome: investigating the biological bases and processes that regulate life, taught in English in Bologna.
programmes.ib: SAT for the first round; later rounds use TOLC-I, which is in Italian.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score in round 1 (TOLC-I in Italian in later rounds). 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: International Studies
programmes.about: International relations for roles in peace, cooperation and sustainable development: how international systems work, taught in English in Forlì.
programmes.ib: Round 1: TOLC-E (in Italian) plus English B2. Round 2: the SAT instead.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your test score: TOLC-E (minimum 8/36) in round 1, SAT in round 2. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: round 1 (TOLC-E) 3 Feb–29 Apr; round 2 (SAT) to 3 July

programmes.name: Management and Economics
programmes.about: Tools, methods and quantitative analysis to help companies compete on global markets, taught in English in Forlì with double-degree options.
programmes.ib: SAT required to apply; below 500 in SAT Math you get an extra maths obligation (OFA).
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your SAT score only. EU places: 35 in round 1, 20 in round 2. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: round 1 10 Feb–4 May; round 2 to 3 July; extra 3–11 Sep

programmes.name: Pharmacy
programmes.about: A five-year pharmacy degree in English that combines science with patient contact, for work across the pharmaceutical supply chain.
programmes.ib: Ranked on the CEnT-S test (in English), taken by the call's deadlines.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your CEnT-S score. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Medicine and Surgery
programmes.about: A six-year medical degree taught entirely in English in Bologna, training doctors to practise in an international setting.
programmes.ib: National admission test in English: 60 questions on general knowledge, logic, biology, chemistry, physics and maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Places set nationally and filled by the admission test score. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Veterinary Medicine
programmes.about: A five-year veterinary degree in English: caring for animals to protect people and the environment, at the Ozzano dell'Emilia campus near Bologna.
programmes.ib: National admission test in English: 60 questions on general knowledge, logic, biology, chemistry, physics and maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Places set nationally and filled by the admission test score. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Every degree has its own call with two or three rounds and separate EU places; the 2027-28 calls are not out yet (in 2026 the SAT degrees opened on 10 February).
As an EU applicant you apply on Studenti Online and pay a small fee (€20 in 2026); Universitaly pre-enrolment is only for non-EU applicants who need a visa.
Two more English degrees are admitted by partners: Biology of Human and Environmental Health through Padua, European Studies through KU Leuven.
